status: offline proposal; integration disabled pending independent review
scope: Mastery: exact namespaceId + course + assignment + examScope, no cross-partition aggregation. Practice XP: complete practice namespace across courses/sets/exams, with no Flight Lab total. null examScope is the course partition; an exam has id,revision,status(tentative|verified),sourceReference.

optionalInput.authority: NEVER accepted from JSON; only injected as trusted Python keyword argument

itemFields: optional responseFormat: choice|value_only|show_work, default show_work; must match trusted attestation

check.extent: unspecified by default; final_answer|whole_solution must be explicit and attested
check.binding: sourceAttempt must exactly equal event sourceAttempt
check.reference: checker/rubric version or explicit owner self-check reference
check.checkedAt: at or after saved revision, at or before asOf
check.errorTypes: optional concept/setup/algebra/units/reading; no stage or XP effect

context.skillIds: 1..100 skill IDs; must include target skill

retiredMilestoneXp: previewAwards is always []; no per-skill or per-set XP and no grandfathered inflation

practiceXp.identity: canonical item identity unioning stable itemId versions and identical contentHash aliases within course, across sets/exams; no skill tag
practiceXp.repeatLimit: worked/closed-note once per item/day on first check of a new attempt; corrections via correctionOf or retryOf once per item lifetime; returns once per item/day on a new attempt
practiceXp.normalization: lazy: only requested practiceXp/levels/weekly namespace views; invalid foreign data yields null global progress plus practice_history_invalid without breaking selected scope

levelPolicy.nextLevelAt: first threshold above total; at 10-15 XP/day increments continue every 8-12 days through a term and beyond

missionPolicy: Plan identities/targets from pre-local-day history only, including pre-day check snapshots; today changes completion, never goal type. Reserve space for proposed Hand-work one: any new problem, with null itemId. New learners receive behavior cards; one item can finish at most one card. retryOf and correctionOf share changed-work repair conditions. Rest/return budget is fixed for the day.

unitPolicy.keyCreation: prepare_answer_key rejects unsupported numeric key units; key_hash and check_final_answer repeat validation before hashing or scoring
unitPolicy.unsupportedKey: ValueError at creation/hash/scoring; never an uncertain learner result
unitPolicy.recognizedMismatch: needs_review + units; no scale conversion or incompatible-dimension acceptance
unitPolicy.futureUnitPicker: general/course-wide SUPPORTED_UNITS, never choices derived from the hidden key; no UI integration

responseFormatPolicy: Only trusted matching responseFormat=choice or value_only allows attested final-answer evidence to count as a complete response for recall. show_work/default still requires whole-solution evidence. Response format is part of the bound item/check evidence; user labels alone grant nothing.
presentationPolicy: Explicit opt-in only. All displays default off, with hide control metadata. No first-run UI, deployment or production wiring is added.
confidence: field required; null means not provided. For new persisted optional-confidence-base-v2 checks, null is neutral for existing activity/recall base rules; no confidence-specific bonus exists. Old untagged null checks retain staging behavior, and all recorded strings keep their original behavior. Confidence alone never establishes independent recall or mastery; trusted evidence remains required

challenge.preset: optional quiz_eve requires 10 families by default
challenge.completionTier: self_checked|check_recorded|final_answer_checked|complete_response_checked|whole_solution_verified; complete-response checks use the same trusted format rule as skills
challenge.correctness: completeResponseVerified requires correct independently checked families; checked coverage alone does not imply correct answers
challenge.methodLimit: methodUnverifiedSources and method-limit wording apply only to show_work final-answer evidence

trustBoundary: VerificationAuthority is injected outside request JSON from trusted immutable independent records. Exact check/extent/outcome/revision/taxonomy bindings are required. User verification labels, method labels and keySource strings never establish verification. Authoritative keys can have source_verified attestations; generated keys need generated_independently_checked attestations. Types are not authentication; a future adapter must own construction and authenticate provenance. No raw course bank or learner work is needed.
currentPracticeContractCompatibility: No direct adapter. Owner self-check remains self-check; current mastery/retention stays not_established and xpAwarded stays 0. Missing future provenance prevents activation.

item.sourceReference: Original synthetic fixture; not an exam question or syllabus
